affectedTables.description: what the batch touches (keyword-anchored, best effort)

estDurationMs.description: measured on the dry run (estimates) and on apply (actuals)

scheduledAt.description:
ScheduledAt is the unix time the change should run; 0 means execute
immediately (on manual apply, as before).

status.description: validated | unverified | failed | approved | applied | rejected

family.description:
Family names the engine family that serves the driver. It is not
stored: the cross-family routes set it when serving.

id.description:
ID is the stable instance identifier used by the cross-family
/external/v1/instances routes. Permissions and changes still link by Name.

documents.description: Documents carries raw engine output as Extended JSON (MongoDB reads).

scratchSchema.description:
ScratchSchema is set by change validation: the throwaway schema the
change was verified against, if any.
